translations.EN: That is not happening.
translations.TL: Hindi iyan mangyayari.

translations.EN: Not a chance. Forget about it.
translations.TL: Walang pag-asa. Kalimutan mo na.

translations.EN: I am not interested in that at all.
translations.TL: Hindi talaga ako interesado riyan.

translations.EN: That is completely off the table.
translations.TL: Wala sa pagpipilian 'yan kailanman.

translations.EN: No. Never going to happen.
translations.TL: Hindi. Di kailanman mangyayari.

translations.EN: Absolutely not.
translations.TL: Hinding-hindi.

translations.EN: I'm shutting that down right now. No.
translations.TL: Papatayin ko ang paksang 'yan ngayon. Hindi.

translations.EN: That won't be happening between us.
translations.TL: Hindi 'yan mangyayari sa pagitan natin.

translations.EN: Drop that idea entirely. Not happening.
translations.TL: Iwan mo nang buo ang ideyang 'yan. Di mangyayari.

translations.EN: No means no. It's not happening.
translations.TL: Ang hindi ay hindi. Di mangyayari 'yan.

translations.EN: Do not talk to me like that.
translations.TL: Huwag mo akong kausapin nang ganyan.

translations.EN: Keep those inappropriate remarks to yourself.
translations.TL: Itago mo sa sarili mo ang di-angkop na mga salitang 'yan.

translations.EN: You're crossing serious personal boundaries.
translations.TL: Tumatawid ka sa seryosong personal na hangganan.

translations.EN: That's completely uncalled for. Stop.
translations.TL: Wala sa lugar 'yan. Tigil.

translations.EN: I don't appreciate that kind of talk.
translations.TL: Hindi ko gusto ang ganyang uri ng pananalita.

translations.EN: Keep your indecent propositions away from me.
translations.TL: Ilayo mo sa akin ang malaswang alok mo.

translations.EN: Watch how you speak to me. That's out of line.
translations.TL: Bantayan mo ang pagsasalita mo sa akin. Sobra na 'yan.

translations.EN: You need to show respect and stop talking like that.
translations.TL: Kailangan mong magpakita ng respeto at tumigil sa ganyang pananalita.

translations.EN: I won't be objectified out here. Back off.
translations.TL: Di ako magpapakababa rito. Umatras ka.

translations.EN: Shut your mouth. Don't speak to me that way.
translations.TL: Itikom mo ang bibig mo. Huwag mo akong kakausapin nang ganyan.

translations.EN: You are moving far too fast.
translations.TL: Masyadong mabilis ang takbo mo.

translations.EN: Slow down. We are nowhere near that point.
translations.TL: Dahan-dahan. Malayo pa tayo sa puntong iyan.

translations.EN: You need to hit the brakes. That's way too fast.
translations.TL: Kailangan mong magpreno. Masyadong mabilis 'yan.

translations.EN: Pace yourself. We barely know each other.
translations.TL: Huwag kang magmadali. Halos di pa nga tayo magkakilala.

translations.EN: You're rushing into territory we haven't earned.
translations.TL: Nagmamadali ka sa lugar na di pa natin nararating.

translations.EN: Slow your roll. That's moving way too fast for me.
translations.TL: Dahan-dahan lang. Masyadong mabilis 'yan para sa akin.

translations.EN: Pull back. We have not built that kind of closeness.
translations.TL: Umatras ka. Wala pa tayong ganyang kalapit na ugnayan.

translations.EN: You're getting way ahead of where we stand.
translations.TL: Nauuna ka nang malayo sa kung ano lang tayo.

translations.EN: Take a massive step back. Way too fast.
translations.TL: Humakbang ka paatras nang malaki. Masyadong mabilis.

translations.EN: Slow down before you ruin whatever trust we have.
translations.TL: Magdahan-dahan ka bago mo sirain ang anumang tiwalang mayroon tayo.
